title: Intebe y'ubwami yagendagenda mu kanya nk'ako gukubita .
intro: Umuntu afise ubukuru burengeye ubw’abandi yari atwara ubwami bw’ubutunzi bwahezagiwe n’ubutunzi burengeye urugero. Igihe haduka ingorane atari yiteze, uwo mutware ntiyashikiwe n’ikigeragezo c’inkota ahubwo c’ubukerebutsi n’ukwizera. Ivyo vyabaye vyari gutuma umuntu ava ku rwego rwo hejuru rw’ububasha bw’isi akaja ku guhinduka gukomeye kw’umutima.
clues: Natwaye ubwami bwahezagiwe n'ubutunzi n'uguterimbere birenze ivyo umuntu yokwiyumvira .
Nari umwami w'ububasha yaronse ikete ry'ubushizi bw'amanga risaba ko yoyoboka .
Abanyacubahiro banje barampaye impanuro ku bijanye no kurwana canke gusezerana n’uwo mwami wo kure .
Naciye mfata inzira mfise ingabirano nziza cane kugira ngo jewe ubwanje nsangane n'uwo mwami wo kure .
Intebe yanje y’ubwami yazanywe mu gihugu ca kure mu kanya nk’ako gukubita urugohe, imbere y’uko nsubirayo .
Igihe ninjira mu kirimba gifise hasi haryoshe nk’ikiyo, amaherezo naramenyesheje ko niyobokera Allah .

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
